Article Title: An American citizen was arrested at airport by Border security for wiping his phone with PIN; Federal judge approves search without warrant; here's what new ruling says on phone and laptop searches
Article Text:
Federal judge approves search without warrant; here's what new ruling says on phone and laptop searches

What the court said

What was the Atlanta case where man wiped his phone with PIN

Here’s what U.S. Customs and Border Protection said about border search of electronic devices at ports of entry

U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is responsible for protecting our nation’s borders and enforcing numerous laws at U.S.

ports of entry. CBP’s ability to lawfully inspect electronic devices crossing the border is integral to keeping America safe in an increasingly digital world.

All travelers crossing the United States border are subject to CBP inspection. On rare occasions, CBP officers may search a traveler’s mobile phone, computer, camera, or other electronic devices during the inspection process. These searches have been used to identify and combat terrorist activity, drug smuggling, human smuggling, bulk cash smuggling, human trafficking, intellectual property rights violations and visa fraud, among other violations.

They enable the discovery of digital contraband, such as child pornography, illicit transfer of restricted or classified information, or other export-controlled information. Furthermore, border searches of electronic devices are often integral to determining an individual’s intentions upon entry to the United States and thus provide additional information relevant to admissibility of foreign nationals under U.S.

immigration laws.

CBP has established strict guidelines, above and beyond prevailing legal requirements, to ensure that these searches are exercised judiciously and responsibly and are consistent with the public trust.

The number of travelers crossing the border that experience a border search of their electronic devices is small. In Fiscal Year (FY) 2025, less than 0.01 percent of arriving international travelers encountered by CBP at a port of entry had their electronic devices searched. Additional statistics are available in the Frequently Asked Questions below and Relevant Policies and Documents box to the right of this page.

US border agents can search people’s phones and other electronic devices without a warrant or any suspicion, a federal judge has ruled. In a ruling last month, the US Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit said that border agents do not need reasonable suspicion before manually searching a traveller's cellphone at the border. The ruling comes months after an Atlanta resident, Samuel Tunick was arrested on charges of destruction of property for wiping his phone with PIN during airport search. Prosecutors then accused Tunick of destroying potential evidence. The latest ruling stemmed from a bank fraud and money laundering case against a man in New York City in 2024.Writing in the 2nd Circuit’s majority opinion, Judge Steven J. Menashi said that border agents in the case stated above and others can “manually” look through someone’s phone or other device without needing to give a reason. In the ruling, Menashi said that there should be no distinction between a phone and other types of property, equating it to luggage or a notebook.“Because a cellphone is property, our precedents establish that the government does not need to have reasonable suspicion before searching a traveler’s cellphone at the border,” he wrote.As reported by The Guardian, Samuel Lutnick’s case centred on GrapheneOS, a custom Android operating system that runs in place of the software on most modern Google Pixel devices.These include the ability to erase a device by entering a designated passcode. The incident occurred at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport on January 24, after Tunick returned from the Dominican Republic. Tunick’s attorneys confirmed GrapheneOS was running on his phone.Agents repeatedly asked Tunick to unlock his phone and warned that it would be seized if he refused. After he eventually provided a passcode, “the screen went blank, flashed several times, and the phone appeared to restart,” according to the defence motion. Data stored on the device was subsequently lost.Prosecutors then alleged that the wipe was a deliberate attempt to destroy potential evidence. Tunick’s lawyers maintain that the underlying search violated his constitutional rights. The GrapheneOS has a feature that allows the device owner to set a passcode that deliberately wipes the contents of that device if entered instead of the user’s unlock passcode.
Article Summary: US border agents can search people’s phones and other electronic devices without a warrant or any suspicion. In a ruling last month, the US Court of Appeals for the 2nd Circuit said that border agents do not need reasonable suspicion before manually searching a traveller's cellphone at the border. The ruling comes months after an Atlanta resident, Samuel Tunick was arrested on charges of destruction of property for wiping his phone with PIN during airport search.

Article Title: How Intel Core Ultra processors fair in performance vs competition
Article Text:
Software and enterprise compatibility

Performance in real-world workloads and gaming

Intel-exclusive technologies

We grew up with “Intel Inside” stickers on our PCs, a branding that made an invisible component a household symbol of trust and raw performance. Yet recent years brought turbulence, with rivals like Qualcomm squeezing Intel’s core market. Today, under the leadership of Lip-Bu Tan, the turnaround seems real. Backed by Washington and crucial partnerships with Nvidia, Intel is regaining its operational stride. The legacy chipmaker launched the Core Ultra Series 3 processors (codenamed Panther Lake) at this year’s CES as Intel's first mobile platform built on the advanced Intel 18A process node – its biggest process innovation – making a strong case for its Core Ultra Series 3 processors in the AI PC race.Given the data in the public domain, the company’s chips seemingly hold advantage over its competitors like Qualcomm’s Snapdragon platform – which compete in the same domain – in three areas: software and enterprise compatibility, real-world workloads like gaming and technologies that only Intel offers. Here is what Intel offers.The Times of India has reached out to Qualcomm for a comment but is yet to hear back.Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors are built on the x86 architecture. This essentially means the full Windows and Chrome OS software ecosystem runs natively on them, with no emulation and no workarounds. For businesses, Intel says this brings native compatibility with decades-old business applications or software, established security agents and enterprise management tools. It also covers the range of peripheral devices that organisations already use.Intel vPro adds another layer on top. According to the company, it gives IT teams a hardware-based way to remotely manage, secure and support devices across large fleets. This includes out-of-band management that works independently of the operating system. Intel describes it as a capability built and tested over years of enterprise use, and one of its strongest selling points for corporate PC buyers.Intel also points to its AI PC platform, which it says supports more than 500 optimised AI models. The company says over 100 independent software vendors (ISVs) are engaged in optimising software for AI PCs.On the performance side, Intel says Core Ultra Series 3 delivers up to 180 TOPS of total AI compute. This comes from the CPU, GPU and NPU working together. The company explains that this mixed design sends each AI workload to the most efficient processing engine for the job, instead of depending on one type of processor. In practice, Intel says this keeps performance steady when several tasks run at once, such as content creation, AI inferencing, video calls and background processes.Gaming is another area Intel highlights. Its x86 architecture works with the full Windows gaming ecosystem. That includes anti-cheat software, older titles, specialised controllers and peripheral drivers. Intel says these are areas where mobile-first architectures still face compatibility gaps.Intel also has a few technologies that set its platform apart.Thunderbolt 4 and 5: Integration of these standards delivers up to 120 Gbps of bandwidth. It supports fast data transfer, daisy-chained displays and universal docking. Intel says this is supported natively across its platforms but is not available on mobile-first architectures.Intel Quick Sync Video: This enables hardware-accelerated video encoding and decoding directly on the processor. Intel says content creators working with high-resolution footage get faster export times, without the CPU load that software encoding demands.
Article Summary: Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processors are built on the x86 architecture. This essentially means the full Windows and Chrome OS software ecosystem runs natively on them. For businesses, Intel says this brings native compatibility with decades-old business applications or software, established security agents and enterprise management tools.

Article Title: Facebook tests Reels-style full-screen video as it prepares new apps for sellers and creators
Article Text:
Facebook tests Reels-style full-screen video as it prepares new apps for sellers and creators

Facebook tests a video-first experience

Facebook launches Seller app for frequent sellers

Meta-owned Facebook is testing a new full-screen video experience that could change what users see when they open the app. The company said it will begin testing the video-first experience later this year, putting some users directly into full-screen video instead of the usual Feed. The move comes as Facebook marks 10 years of Marketplace and launches new tools for sellers, including a separate app called Seller. In a note by Tom Allison, Head of Facebook, Meta, the company said that it is also rolling out a free verification badge and bringing more AI tools to people who sell, create and build communities on the platform.Tom Alison said the company is working on a new experience for people who want more video on Facebook. “Beyond evolving the tools for people who do things on Facebook, we’re also thinking about the experience for people who come to be entertained and connect with authentic creators. People are showing us they want more immersive, visual, video-forward experiences, and video is where conversations are happening, communities are forming, and even commerce is starting to take place,” Alison said.“So later this year, we’ll begin testing a reimagined experience that puts a subset of people who we think want more video on Facebook into full-screen video the moment they open the app,” he added.Under the test, some users will see full-screen video as soon as they open the Facebook app. The company's Classic Feed will remain available as a second tab.The video test is being announced as Facebook Marketplace reaches its 10th anniversary.Alison said Marketplace was created after Facebook noticed people were already using Groups to buy and sell products.Facebook is also testing a new app called Seller, designed for people who sell frequently on Marketplace. The app brings several selling tools together in one place. These include:- AI-powered listing creation- A unified inbox- Inventory management- Performance insightsThe app will remain connected to Facebook, meaning sellers can continue reaching buyers and their communities through the same network. Facebook said the goal is to make selling easier for people who list large numbers of products.
Article Summary: Facebook tests Reels-style full-screen video as it prepares new apps for sellers and creators. The move comes as Facebook marks 10 years of Marketplace and launches new tools for sellers, including a separate app called Seller. The company's Classic Feed will remain available as a second tab.

Article Title: OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in Europe, here's what it means for users
Article Text:
What is changing

How the watermark works

Limits of detection

What it means for users

Who gets the detector

ChatGPT-maker OpenAI has announced that it will add invisible watermarks to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for users in the European Union, as the company moves to comply with new requirements under the EU AI Act. The company also said that the rollout will being over the coming weeks and will apply to eligible ChatGPT and Codex text outputs across all plans in the EU. The move is designed to make AI-generated text identifiable in a machine-readable way while promoting greater transparency around AI-created content.OpenAI said that over the coming weeks it will add the watermark to eligible text output from ChatGPT and Codex. The change covers all plans in the EU and nowhere else. The company said it is not making text watermarking a global default at launch and described the regional approach as a way to learn from real-world use and feedback.The company is also making watermarking available to developers. Starting immediately, API customers worldwide can opt in to watermarked text for select models. It stays off by default in the API. OpenAI said it is working with cloud partners to offer watermarking for its models through their services in the coming weeks.OpenAI's technology, called textGrain, adds a statistical signal to the model's word choices. Readers cannot see it. A detector looks for that pattern to judge whether a passage carries an OpenAI watermark. OpenAI has published a technical report on the method and said it plans to release the technology as open source.The company said textGrain matched or beat the other approaches it tested, including SynthID for text. It added that strong results under ideal conditions do not guarantee reliable detection in everyday use.OpenAI's own evaluations show where the technology struggles:* Length matters. At a 1% false positive rate, the detector found watermarks in about 80% of 200-token passages and about 95% of 400-token passages in content such as psychology. Detection was substantially lower for content such as mathematics, where there is less flexibility in word choice.* Editing weakens the signal. In tests on 400-token passages, swapping 10% of words for synonyms cut detection from about 92% to 66%. Swapping 25% cut it to 17%.What a watermark does and does not showOpenAI listed several things a detection result cannot tell anyone:* It does not measure how much a human contributed to the text.* It does not establish who owns the text or who is responsible for it.* It does not identify the user. It does not link the text to a person, account, prompt or conversation.* It does not verify whether the text is accurate.* The absence of a watermark does not prove a human wrote the text. Short, edited or translated text may evade detection. Text may also come from an unsupported model, predate watermarking or come from another company's tools.For people using ChatGPT or Codex in the EU, the visible experience should not change, since the marker cannot be seen. OpenAI said it found no meaningful quality difference in tests of its latest frontier model, Astra, with and without watermarking. On eight benchmarks, the scores were close, with the watermarked version slightly ahead on some and slightly behind on others.Users should understand that a watermark is not a verdict on authorship. Because it can be weakened by editing and does not identify users, it is not a reliable way to prove who wrote a passage. That matters for anyone who might otherwise treat a detection result as proof, such as teachers, employers and publishers.OpenAI said the detector does not reveal users' prompts or conversations.OpenAI is not releasing the text detector to the public. Researchers and expert organizations can apply for access, which will be granted case by case under the EU's Code of Practice on AI-generated content. The company said the risk of missed watermarks and false positives is the reason it is holding back a public release.Its tools for images and audio remain publicly available. These include a web verification tool at openai.com/verify and a Content Provenance API.
Article Summary: ChatGPT-maker OpenAI will add invisible watermarks to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for users in the European Union. The move is designed to make AI- generated text identifiable in a machine-readable way while promoting greater transparency around AI-created content.

Article Title: India’s First Agentic AI Campus Takes Shape at KLH Hyderabad
Article Text: KLH Hyderabad today inaugurated its Agentic AI Campus initiative and signed an MoU with HCL Group AI Labs, unveiling a roadmap that places AI-powered learning and student innovation at the centre of its academic vision. The collaboration aims to equip students across disciplines to understand, build and apply intelligent technologies through practical projects, faculty mentorship and industry engagement. Mr. Deepak Sarvanan, National Head, HCL Group AI Labs, formally inaugurated the initiative at a press meet in KLH Bachupally campus in Hyderabad.Dr. L. Koteswara Rao, Principal, KLH Bachupally, represented KLH at the MoU exchange, alongside Dr. A. Srinath, Dean – Skill Development, in the presence of other senior officials, deans, faculty and staff.The initiative aims to make AI an integral part of the student experience. From exploring concepts in the classroom to developing applications, students will be encouraged to use AI to investigate problems, test ideas and create solutions relevant to industry and society.Er. Koneru Lakshman Havish, Vice President, KL Deemed to be University said, “We want students to develop the confidence and skills to shape how AI is used in their chosen fields.Our collaboration with HCL Group AI Labs will help connect classroom learning with hands-on projects and industry expertise, giving students opportunities to build intelligent solutions for real-world needs. As we develop our Agentic AI Campus, our focus is on preparing young people to innovate responsibly and contribute meaningfully to an evolving workplace. ”Agentic AI brings a new dimension to this approach. These systems can plan and carry out a series of tasks towards a defined goal, with appropriate human oversight. Understanding how such systems work will help students explore applications that extend from analysing information to coordinating workflows and supporting decisions.The proposed roadmap envisages project-based learning in areas such as business automation, data-driven services and discipline-specific AI applications. Students will be encouraged to design and test solutions, evaluating their accuracy, reliability and practical value.Faculty readiness will be a key part of the campus’s development. The collaboration envisages supporting educators in integrating AI into teaching, assignments and mentorship, helping students connect technical understanding with critical thinking and independent judgement.Responsible AI use will remain central to the learning approach, with attention to data privacy, bias, reliability and human accountability. Students will be encouraged to question outputs, verify information and understand the limitations of the systems they develop and use.Through its collaboration with HCL Group AI Labs, KLH Hyderabad aims to strengthen the connection between academic learning and the evolving workplace across its Bachupally and Aziznagar campuses, preparing students to develop AI solutions and apply them thoughtfully to real-world challenges.
Article Summary: KLH Hyderabad has signed an MoU with HCL Group AI Labs. The initiative aims to make AI an integral part of the student experience. Students will be encouraged to use AI to investigate problems, test ideas and create solutions relevant to industry and society.

The immigration authority shared a post on X (formerly Twitter), stating that “Digital submissions help us receive, store, and access information more efficiently, supporting stronger fraud detection, identity management, and national security screening.” The post also has a link to the ‘Online Filing Options’ website listing forms that are available for online filing, benefits of filing a form online, among others.There are two options for submitting forms from a USCIS online account, the webpage states. The first is filling out an online form electronically where you are guided step-by-step through the form to answer questions that are relevant to your form type and category. The second online filing option allows you to upload and submit a completed PDF file of your form and related evidence. Both filing options have similar features to manage your case in your online account.Almost all USCIS forms can be filed online. Some of these are:Sign in to your USCIS online account or create a USCIS online account, if you do not already have one. Go to our Sign Up page. If you need help creating a USCIS online account, please visit our How to Create a USCIS Online Account page.You must provide a valid email address and password to create a USCIS online account. The email address you provide will also be the username for your USCIS online account. The USCIS online account uses a two-factor authentication process. This means that in addition to entering your username and password, you must also enter a 1-time verification code that USCIS will send you by email, text message, or authentication app, each time you sign into your account. When you create your USCIS online account, you can select how you want to receive the 1-time verification code. If you select text message, enter your U.S. mobile phone number in the Mobile Number box (standard SMS/text messaging rates may apply). If you select the app option, the system will generate a code that you can scan or type into an authentication app that you have installed on your mobile device (such as Google Authenticator).To sign in to your USCIS online account using two-factor authentication:Select “File a Form Online.”Select the form you want to file.Select “Fill Out Form Fields Online.”Complete all sections of your form.Fill out all sections of the form as completely as possible.Read the form instructions for information on completing fields when your answer is “zero” or “not applicable (N/A).”Upload evidence.You may need to provide evidence when you file to support your application, petition, or request. These documents help us evaluate your form and verify information you have provided.Use these tips when uploading evidence:If USCIS require passport-style photos, you must either scan them or take a picture with your phone.Review and digitally sign your form.Review the summary of the information you provided in your application, petition, or request. You may save and print a copy for your records.To digitally sign your application, petition, or request, enter your full legal name (first, middle, and last names) in the space provided. The system will affix your signature and the date to your online application. After you submit your application, petition, or request, you cannot make any changes.Pay the filing fee, if applicable.You must pay with a valid credit or debit card or provide your bank routing and checking account numbers to have money taken directly from your U.S. bank account.After you make your payment, your form will be submitted. If there is no fee associated with your application, then the form will be submitted directly to USCIS.For most forms, you will immediately receive a receipt notice that contains your receipt number. For some forms, it may take up to 3 days to receive a receipt number. A receipt number is a unique number that applies to your specific case with USCIS. You can find your receipt number on your online account home page, and you can find a copy of your receipt notice under the Documents or Notices tab, as applicable.View appointment notices.USCIS may schedule you for a biometric services appointment at an application support center. Log in to your USCIS online account for more information about your appointment.You must attend this appointment and provide biometric information, which may include your photograph, signature, and fingerprints.If you need to attend an interview, you will also receive an interview appointment notice in your account.Respond to Requests for Evidence and upload unsolicited evidence.USCIS will notify you by text message or email (based on your preference) if you need to respond to a Request for Evidence (RFE).Log in to your USCIS online account and go to the “Documents or Notices” tab, as applicable, to view notices and respond to the RFE.While your case is pending, you may provide additional information, including evidence USCIS did not specifically request, about your case. If you do not have an open RFE, you can do this in the “Documents or Evidence” tab, as applicable. Look for the additional evidence uploader at the bottom of the tab.Check the status of your case.Log in to your USCIS online account for details on the status of your case.Send and receive secure messages.After you file a form, you will have access to a secure inbox to send messages to USCIS and receive responses to your questions.Receive a decision.Log in to your USCIS online account to read details of the decision made on your case. For information on processing times for all forms, please visit our USCIS Processing Time Information page.
Article Summary: USCIS will soon mandate online filing for many immigration forms that have been available for e-filing for at least 180 days. The immigration authority shared a post on X (formerly Twitter) stating that “Digital submissions help us receive, store, and access information more efficiently”

Article Title: As Google and SpaceX plan to solve the 'data centers problem' by taking them to the Sun; some researchers in Japan and Germany want to fix it right on Earth, and their solution is ...
Article Text:
AI-generated image for representation

How elastocaloric cooling works

How elastocaloric cooling can help data centers

Technology is still at the proof-of-concept stage

Data centers are putting increasing pressure on power grids as demand for computing continues to grow. Some companies are exploring alternatives such as solar-powered facilities while tech giants like Google and SpaceX are even planning to move data centers away from Earth. Recently, Google launched its homegrown AI chips into orbit aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket as part of Project Suncatcher, its effort to develop solar-powered AI computing infrastructure in space. The launch marked the project's first in-orbit test, which aims to use continuously available solar power and the “infinite real estate” of orbit for AI computing.As this approach explores moving computing infrastructure off-planet, researchers in Japan and Germany are working on a way to tackle the data center cooling problem without leaving Earth. Their solution uses shape memory alloy films in a system called “elastocaloric cooling.” The technology, known as “elastocaloric cooling,” uses a titanium-nickel alloy film that changes shape in response to heat and drives a refrigeration cycle. The study, published in Nature Energy, presents a prototype that could eventually find applications in data centers and other computing devices, although the current system remains at the proof-of-concept stage.The prototype consists of a thermal actuator and a cooling unit. Its thermal actuator uses a shape memory alloy film made from titanium-nickel. When the film reaches a sufficiently high temperature, it stretches and generates force that elongates a separate refrigerant film.The refrigerant film eventually contacts a heat sink, which removes heat from the film. As the actuator and refrigerant films cool, they return to their original shapes. The refrigerant film then contacts the heat source and absorbs heat, restarting the cycle.According to the researchers, the cooling process takes place through four steps involving the heating, deformation, cooling and recovery of the films. The system is designed to repeat the process continuously without requiring a conventional motor to drive the cooling operation.The research paper does not specifically propose the technology for data center cooling. However, the approach could potentially address one of the challenges associated with large computing facilities: the energy and water required to keep hardware within operating temperatures.Data centers use substantial amounts of electricity, while conventional cooling systems can add to their energy requirements. Some cooling systems also use water. A cooling technology based on shape memory alloy films could potentially reduce the need for some conventional cooling infrastructure if it can be scaled.The same principle could also have applications beyond large data centers, including personal computers and other electronic devices.The prototype currently has significant limitations. The researchers reported that the films generated only **2.09 milliwatts of cooling power**. The system was also limited by relatively slow actuation and the size of its heat exchanger.These limitations mean the technology is not yet ready to replace the cooling systems used in large computing facilities. Scaling cooling output while improving the system's speed and efficiency would be necessary before practical applications become possible.Still, the research demonstrates that elastocaloric cooling can work using shape-changing films rather than conventional motor-driven refrigeration. If researchers can overcome the current limitations, the approach could eventually offer another way to manage heat in computing hardware, including the increasingly power-hungry systems used in AI data centers.
Article Summary: Researchers in Japan and Germany are working on a way to tackle the data center cooling problem without leaving Earth. Their solution uses shape memory alloy films in a system called “elastocaloric cooling.” The technology, known as ‘elast vocaloric cooling,’ uses a titanium-nickel alloy film that changes shape in response to heat. The study presents a prototype that could eventually find applications in data centers.

Article Title: UIDAI announces new SOP for changing name on Aadhaar, here's what you need to know
Article Text:
UIDAI announces new SOP for changing name on Aadhaar, here's what you need to know

The basic rules for name change in Aadhaar

What counts as a minor Aadhaar name change

Expanding or abbreviating initials (for example, T R D Prasad becoming Tadi Rama Durga Prasad)

Adding or deleting a middle or last name

Changing the sequence or order of an existing name (Divakar Anand to Anand Divakar)

Minor spelling corrections (Ram to Rama)

Regional language errors get their own track

Marriage or divorce-related surname changes require an affidavit (Annexure D) along with PoI.

Name changes due to gender transition require applicable PoI documentation.

Updating a child's Aadhaar from "Baby of ___" to an actual name can be done on a Head-of-Family basis, with applicable PoR.

Dropping ranks, designations, or prefixes, and removing random capital letters or dots, require no supporting documents at all.

Removing an "urf" or alias entry requires an affidavit along with PoI or PoR.

Major name changes need a Gazette Notification

How many times can you change your name on Aadhaar card

What users need to do to for name change on Aadhaar card

Visit an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Aadhaar Enrolment/Update Centre. the process requires an in-person visit; it is not currently available end-to-end online for most categories of name change.

Fill out the Aadhaar Enrolment/Update form, writing the name in block letters, free of titles, aliases, or unapproved abbreviations.

Submit the prescribed supporting documents based on the specific category the request falls under — ranging from a simple PoI for minor corrections to a mandatory Gazette Notification for a major name change.

Complete identity verification and biometric authentication at the centre as part of the same visit.

Pay the applicable demographic update fee, currently listed by UIDAI at ₹75 when a name update is processed as a standalone request.

Collect the acknowledgement receipt, which includes an Update Request Number (URN) that can be used to track the status of the request online afterward.

UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) has issued a revised Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for updating names in Aadhaar. The authority has introduced separate rules and documents requirements depending on the type of name change being requested. The new SOP, which came into effect on September 18, 2026, replaces the earlier process introduced in 2021. The updated procedure categorises requests into multiple categories, including minor spelling corrections, data-entry errors, surname changes after marriage or divorce, regional-language corrections and major name changes. According to UIDAI, documents, affidavits and Gazette notifications submitted with requests will be subject to stricter verification to prevent misuse and identity-related fraud.Under the revised SOP, names recorded in Aadhaar must appear in block letters, with no titles, prefixes (such as Shri, Smt, Ms, Dr, or Prof), aliases, ranks, or special characters permitted. Updates are governed under Regulation 19 of the Aadhaar (Enrolment & Update) Regulations, 2016, and any name change must be backed by documents listed under Schedule II. A name will be updated exactly as it appears — in spelling, sequence, and abbreviation — in the document the applicant submits as proof.UIDAI treats several routine corrections as minor name changes, requiring only standard Proof of Identity (PoI), or Proof of Relationship (PoR) for children under 18:These are accepted as long as the new name matches a PoI or PoR document the applicant has already submitted to UIDAI in the past.A separate category covers cases where the English spelling of a name on Aadhaar is correct, but the regional-language version contains an error — for instance, निर्मला being incorrectly recorded as निर्मल. These cases also require a standard PoI document to correct.Special cases with dedicated requirementsThe SOP carves out specific documentation paths for several commonly occurring situations:The strictest category under the new SOP covers a complete change of name or identity — for example, Ram Gupta becoming Shyam Gupta, or a more substantial identity shift. For these cases, UIDAI will accept only a Gazette Notification as proof, alongside standard identity documents; no other form of documentation is considered sufficient. The authority will also cross-check the proposed new name against every name previously recorded for that Aadhaar holder, and verify the authenticity of the Gazette Notification and any affidavits submitted.Under UIDAI's existing framework, a person can generally update their Aadhaar name twice in total. Once that limit is exhausted, any further name change requests must go through a separate exception-handling process. For context, gender on Aadhaar can typically be changed only once, and date of birth only once as well, under separate SOPs UIDAI maintains for those fields.To apply for a name correction or change under the new SOP, applicants need to follow a set sequence of steps:

The new SOP, which came into effect on September 18, 2026, replaces the earlier process introduced in 2021. The updated procedure categorises requests into multiple categories, including minor spelling corrections, data- entry errors and surname changes after marriage or divorce.

Article Title: Apple CEO John Ternus on how Steve Jobs’ ‘furniture story’ inspires product design at the company
Article Text:
The ‘carpenter's lesson’

Apple CEO John Ternus, who recently stepped into the top leadership position after guiding the company’s hardware engineering teams across multiple device generations, has shared how an iconic Steve Jobs philosophy continues to dictate Apple ’s design standards – even on its most budget-friendly devices. Speaking soon after the launch of the MacBook Neo earlier this year, Ternus revisited one of his favourite stories about the late Apple co-founder, illustrating how attention to unseen details remains the foundation of the company’s product line.Ternus recounted a quiet moment involving Jobs moving a bedroom dresser away from the wall.“Steve was moving a piece of furniture, a chest of drawers, and pulled it away from the wall and looked at the back and was just reflecting on the carpenter who had made it beautiful. It finished the back as beautifully as the rest of it, even though nobody was going to see it right and I think about that all the time because I think that perfectly exemplifies what we do here,” he said.The mindset of treating internal components and unseen surfaces with the same engineering precision as the exterior casing has been a foundational rule of Apple hardware since the earliest Macintosh models. Ternus connected that design ethos directly to the MacBook Neo, pointing out that cost-effective pricing does not mean cutting corners on aesthetic or structural integrity.“We've been talking about the MacBook Neo. Here is our most affordable Mac we've ever made, and it's absolutely beautiful. And if you open it up and look inside, it's just as beautiful,” Tetanus said.“And that's true about all products – an iPhone Pro Max or a MacBook Pro or an iPad Pro, but it's also true on a MacBook Neo,” he added, suggesting that Apple applies the exact same standards to its entry-level hardware.For Ternus, continuing to obsess over hidden details provides a clear roadmap for where the company is headed under his tenure.“That's what we do, and so, it's just been really good just to think about that and reflect on that because that is probably the best kind of clue as to where we're going in the future. We're going to keep pushing in that same way,” Ternus said.
Article Summary: Apple CEO John Ternus has shared how an iconic Steve Jobs philosophy continues to dictate Apple’s design standards. He recounted a quiet moment involving Jobs moving a bedroom dresser away from the wall. The mindset of treating internal components and unseen surfaces with the same engineering precision as the exterior casing has been a foundational rule of Apple hardware.

Article Title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 patch notes: Ice Caves Biome, Frostbite Mob, and more
Article Text:
Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 is out with new features from the upcoming game drop (Image via Mojang)

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 patch notes

New Features

Added the new Ice Caves Biome

Added Ice Crystals

Added Icicles

Added the Frostbite mob

Added the Freezing mob effect

Added the Ice Ball

Ice Caves

The Ice Cave is a new cave biome that generates beneath colder Overworld biomes.

It's built mainly from Packed Ice and Calcite, with Icicles hanging from the ceiling and Large Icicles made of Packed Ice forming both on the ground and overhead.

Patches of Snow occasionally appear on the floor, and ores generate embedded within pockets of Stone and Deepslate.

Alongside typical cave mobs, Strays and Frostbites can also spawn in this biome, and Ice Crystals occasionally generate on the ground.

Ice Crystal is a new crystal-like block similar to Amethyst Clusters. It breaks if its support block is removed, emits light, and can be placed in any direction.

Icicle is a new block in the same family as Dripstone and Sulfur Spikes. Icicles can naturally grow up to 5 blocks long when pointing downward, but only in areas without nearby light sources and never in the Nether.

Frostbite

The Frostbite is a new zombie variant capable of throwing Ice Balls.

It spawns in cold and icy biomes and switches between melee and ranged combat depending on target distance and whether it's currently holding Ice Balls.

Melee attacks apply the Freezing effect, while ranged attacks throw Ice Balls directly.

Frostbites transform into regular Zombies if left underwater long enough, and they drop Rotten Flesh and Ice Balls on death.

They can stand on top of Powder Snow and are immune to freezing, so neither the Freezing effect nor Powder Snow slows them down.

Interestingly, regular Zombies and Husks will transform into Frostbites if they stand inside Powder Snow.

Freezing Mob Effect

The Freezing effect causes affected players to shake and eventually take damage, gradually freezing them as though standing in Powder Snow for the duration.

Leather Armor offers protection from freezing, the same way it does against Powder Snow, though it won't prevent the effect from being applied or remove it once active.

Mobs vulnerable to Freezing take a 5x damage multiplier while affected.

Lingering Potions, Splash Potions, and a new Potion of Freezing can all be brewed using Ice Balls, and Arrows of Freezing can be crafted by placing a Lingering Potion of Freezing in the center of a crafting table surrounded by eight Arrows.

Ice Ball

Ice Balls are the new projectile thrown by Frostbites. They deal a small amount of damage along with knockback, dealing up to 4 damage on impact, scaling down based on velocity. They break apart on contact with blocks or entities, triggering a particle effect and sound.

Changes

Minor tweaks to Blocks, Items and Entities

Snow can now be placed on Packed Ice

Snowballs now apply knockback to players

UI

Lightmap visualization is now configurable as lightmap_texture in debug options and appears in the Light group; its visibility is saved with the debug profile and can now be displayed alongside the FPS and network charts

The Social Interactions screen has been replaced with the new Other Players screen

The "Social Interactions" keybind has been renamed to "Other Players"

The Friends button has received a new icon

The "Visibility" option has moved from Online Options into the Friends list

Icon buttons in the pause menu have been reordered to match the main menu

Friends

Updated the design of the Friends list

Added searching - the profile name text box in the Friends tab now doubles as a search box, and a search box appears in the requests tab once you have 15 or more pending requests

Added sorting - a new sort button cycles between sorting by who's online and alphabetical order

Clicking a player's icon in the Friends list now opens their Player Options

Removed the "Remove Friend" button; this is now handled through Player Options instead

Player Reporting

Redesigned the save/discard draft confirmation screen

Saved report drafts no longer prompt you to discard them when exiting a world, if they can be continued later

Chat reports can never be continued; Name and Skin reports can be continued if the reported player is still in your Friends list

Pressing "Quit Game" in the main menu now warns you if an unsent draft report would be lost

Debug Overlay

Added chunk_section_status, showing the rendering status of chunks around you (impacts performance at high view distances)

Split the chunk load overlay off from visualize_chunks_on_server into a new chunk_load_status

Technical Changes

Data Pack version is now 123.0

Resource Pack version is now 100.0

Numerous world generation changes, including a reworked minecraft:speleothem_cluster feature with new placement options, a renamed minecraft:large_dripstone feature, new Ice Cave ore placements, a new minecraft:block_sound_set registry, several new block/item/biome tags for pathfinding and ore replacement, and a new minecraft:freezing particle type

Numerous new block, item, UI, and entity textures and sounds added to support Ice Caves, Icicles, Ice Crystals, the Frostbite, and the Freezing effect

Several UI textures renamed or removed as part of the Friends and Other Players redesign

Fixed Bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 3

MC-212616 - The dye staining sound does not play when dyes are used on tamed wolves or cats

MC-303468 - Pets can be teleported to incorrect coordinates when going through a nether portal

MC-306017 - The main arm doesn't swing when making a tamed wolf sit or stand while holding a matching dye

MC-307830 - Framerate limited to 20 fps with the Vulkan rendering backend on some systems

MC-308037 - Unselected tabs in the friends menu show white text instead of gray

MC-308051 - Icons on several buttons don't adhere to the UI pixel grid

MC-308747 - The social interactions button is grayed out in LAN worlds with no players

MC-308994 - The Chat Restrictions screen doesn't display Xbox communication settings affecting chat

MC-309896 - Missing periods on two tooltip strings

MC-309906 - Inconsistent capitalization of "Friends List" across strings

MC-310124 - Leaving a keyboard-opened menu doesn't reselect its button on the previous screen

MC-310237 - A friends error string uses an em dash inconsistently

MC-310854 - Inconsistent button outlines in the friends screen

MC-311932 - Caps Lock could no longer trigger sprint/sneak toggles set to "Hold"

MC-311963 - A Poplar leaves subtitle string used incorrect grammar

MC-312120 - Exclusive Fullscreen toggle button doesn't update properly in windowed mode

MC-312198 - Almost no small mushrooms generate on mushroom islands

MC-312213 - Game crashes with custom Superflat presets containing air

Mojang has released Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4, giving players their first hands-on look at the frosty new game drop teased at Minecraft Live. The headline addition is the Ice Caves Biome, a new underground environment filled with icicles and glowing Ice Crystals, alongside the Frostbite - a chilling new zombie variant that can freeze players with its attacks.Beyond the frozen content, this snapshot also brings a significant overhaul to the Friends system, introducing a refreshed list design, new search and sorting tools, and a redesigned Other Players menu. In the section below, we take a detailed look at everything new in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4.Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install, open the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.This was all you needed to know about Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 patch notes.
Article Summary: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 3 is out with new features from the upcoming game drop. Ice Caves is a new cave biome that generates beneath colder Overworld biomes. Frostbites are a new zombie variant capable of throwing Ice Balls. Snowballs now apply knockback to players.

Article Title: Is Minecraft Dungeons 2 cross platform? Crossplay and multiplayer explained
Article Text:
Minecraft Dungeons II officially supports cross-platform (Image via Mojang)

Is Minecraft Dungeons 2 crossplay?

How co-op works in Minecraft Dungeons II

Turning on Cross-platform in Minecraft Dungeons II

Launch Minecraft Dungeons II and go to the main menu.

Open Settings and look for the Game options section.

Find Cross-Platform Play and toggle it on.

Crossplay vs. Cross-Progression

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Subscription requirements

Minecraft Dungeons II launched on September 29, 2026, and the new dungeon crawler has received a solid reception from the community. For anyone planning to squad up with friends across different consoles, the good news arrived early: crossplay is fully supported.If you are looking for further details, you are at the right place. Here's a breakdown of how multiplayer works, what crossplay actually covers, and what to know before jumping into a session.Yes. Minecraft Dungeons II supports cross-platform play across every system it launched on: PC, Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch, for parties of up to four players. This builds on a feature the original Minecraft Dungeons already had, so Mojang carried the functionality forward into the sequel rather than building it from scratch.Official store listings and Xbox have both confirmed cross-platform multiplayer and cross-platform co-op, meaning a group spread across PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC can all land in the same session without workarounds. Mojang hasn't published a detailed platform-by-platform compatibility chart, so the exact mechanics of every possible pairing aren't fully spelled out.Minecraft Dungeons II supports up to four players at once, whether that's entirely online, entirely local couch co-op, or a mix of both happening in the same session.That hybrid option, officially called Mixed Co-Op, is one of the sequel's standout multiplayer additions, since the original game required players to choose one mode or the other rather than blending them.Joining a session works two ways: through matchmaking, which fills empty slots automatically, or by sharing an eight-character party code with friends so they can join a specific lobby directly, regardless of what platform they're on.Cross-platform play is tied to account sign-in rather than being fully automatic. To enable it:Once enabled, the setting stays active going forward unless manually turned off from the same menu.It's worth separating two related but different features. Crossplay lets players on different platforms share a session together. Cross-progression is about carrying a saved character from one platform to another. Mojang has confirmed that hero data is stored online rather than locally, so progress follows players who sign in with the same Microsoft account across devices.Online console multiplayer isn't entirely free of extra requirements. Xbox players need an active Game Pass tier that includes online multiplayer, while PlayStation players need an active PlayStation Plus subscription to play online. PC players don't need anything beyond owning the game, and it's also available through Game Pass on day one as an Xbox Play Anywhere title.To conclude it all, squads spread across different consoles can enjoy Minecraft Dungeons II together. Now you can easily jump into a friend's game using party codes and have a blast playing the game. The big things to double check before you go are having an active online subscription on consoles and making sure cross platform play is toggled on in settings.
Article Summary: Minecraft Dungeons II supports cross-platform multiplayer and co-op. This means a group spread across PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and PC can all land in the same session without workarounds. Cross-progression is about carrying a saved character from one platform to another.

Article Title: From crash-test airbags to Formula E: Heron Preston’s journey with discarded materials
Article Text:
Heron Preston partners with Formula E to explore sustainable motorsport fashion

From sanitation uniforms to Formula E: Heron Preston gives waste a new life

Heron Preston brings crash-test airbags, recycled materials into Formula E fashion

From fashion to motorsport for Heron Preston

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

For Heron Preston, discarded materials are not simply waste. They can become something new. The designer has built his work around finding new uses for materials that are often overlooked. Now, that approach is coming to motorsport through a creative partnership with Formula E, where fashion, performance and sustainability will come together. The partnership will explore how existing materials can be reused to create clothing, products and other items linked to motorsport.Heron Preston has explored the potential of unwanted materials through several projects. His 2016 UNIFORM project used upcycled decommissioned New York City Department of Sanitation uniforms and second-hand garments.More recently, he worked with Mercedes-Benz to transform crash-test airbags into garments. The clothes retained the distinctive physical qualities of the material. His approach is based on looking closely at every part of a product, from the materials used to how they are made and the people and processes involved. He calls this concept eX-Ray.ID@undefined Caption not available.Rather than simply choosing existing fabrics, eX-Ray looks at how materials can be developed and used in a more considered way.For the Formula E partnership, Heron Preston is using recycled cotton made from pre-consumer factory off-cuts and production scraps. The materials are sorted, shredded and re-spun into new yarn before being developed into a heavyweight, tightly woven fabric. The idea fits with Formula E’s own focus on recovering and reusing resources.While Preston turns recovered materials into new designs, Formula E uses regenerative braking to recover energy and use it again for racing. Together, the two sides want to explore how this thinking can be applied to motorsport fashion from the beginning of the design process.The partnership will look at more than clothing. The partners hope to explore performance wear, fan merchandise, accessories and products made from upcycled materials drawn from the sport. They also want to find new uses for components and materials after their life in racing.The GEN4 car provides an example of Formula E’s approach. It is designed to be 100% recyclable or reusable, with at least 20% recycled materials across key components.Talking about the same, Heron Preston said, “This creative partnership is about rethinking what motorsport fashion can be. I’ve always been interested in taking materials, processes and ideas from unexpected places and finding new ways to give them purpose. Working with Formula E gives me the opportunity to bring that approach into a world where performance is everything. We’re looking at how apparel can be thoughtfully designed from the material up, balancing function, quality and a more considered approach to how things are made.The partnership will be previewed at ComplexCon Los Angeles on October 3 and 4. The event will feature an exploration of eX-Ray materials and a GEN4 Formula E car with an exclusive Preston-designed livery.Ellie Norman, Chief Marketing Officer, Formula E, said, “Heron and Formula E share a curiosity about how things work and how they can be made better. In racing, we push for greater performance while using energy and materials more efficiently. Heron brings a complementary perspective, exploring what existing materials can become through design. This partnership gives us the opportunity to develop those ideas together and apply them to the products people wear. ComplexCon is the first look at that shared ambition, with the potential to build a more considered approach to motorsport fashion over time.”Also read: Formula E, Heron Preston join hands to bring recycled materials to motorsport fashion
Article Summary: Designer Heron Preston partners with Formula E to explore sustainable motorsport fashion. The partnership will explore how existing materials can be reused to create clothing, products and other items linked to motorsport. Preston has previously worked with Mercedes-Benz to transform crash-test airbags into garments.
